messages:
maria_s: Heads-up — customer reports invoice shows ~3x tokens versus dashboard for a streaming call they aborted mid-generation. They attached invoice 2026-03-02-INV-914 and sample request.
alex_r: Can you drop the request_id + example curl here? we need model + stream flag.
maria_s: request=req_live_0x9f1, model=redwood-v2-medium, stream=SSE. curl they used: ```curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-medium","input":"<long prompt>","stream":true}'``` they ctrl-c after first 2 data frames.
support_bot: Ticket #5487 linked to thread.
jordan_p: Hypothesis — finalizer may be replaying prefix tokens after partial chunks were already metered. I think kv-cache warmup + cancel edge-case double-counts.
maria_s: Ledger snippet (sanitized): ```2026-03-02T09:12:01Z meter_ingest req=req_live_0x9f1 tokens=140
2026-03-02T09:12:01Z stream_chunk_sent req=req_live_0x9f1 chunk_tokens=70
2026-03-02T09:12:02Z client_cancel req=req_live_0x9f1
2026-03-02T09:12:03Z finalizer_flush req=req_live_0x9f1 tokens_added=140``` Invoice total = 210 which matches customer claim.
alex_r: That finalizer_flush +140 is the culprit. chunk_logged 70 earlier, finalizer adding full prefix. We need to see if finalizer checks existing chunk rows.
billing_team: We aggregate the ledger rows into invoices. If both rows exist, they'll be summed. Share any repro so we can correlate sequence ids.
jordan_p: Repro plan: enable KV_CACHE locally, stream a long prompt, cancel after N SSE frames, then inspect /internal/metering/events and DB rows. I'll spin a staging instance and try.
maria_s: My quick repro on staging (KV_CACHE=1): `curl -N ... | head -n 2` then `SELECT * FROM token_ledger WHERE request_id='req_live_0x9f1' ORDER BY ts;` results: 70, 140 (finalizer). invoice math = 210.
billing_bot: Flagged P2 -> assign alex_r, jordan_p.
alex_r: Short-term mitigation: make finalizer idempotent by switching to upsert keyed by (request_id, finalizer_seq) or set finalized=true before applying. I'll draft a PR to gate duplicate writes.
jordan_p: Observed additional noise from client reverse proxy — heartbeats between SSE frames: ```data: {"text":"part A","tokens":70}
:hb
data: {"text":"part B","tokens":70}``` When TCP close happens, we still run finalizer which replays prefix tokens. Need to ensure finalizer subtracts already-minted chunk tokens or skips if a chunk row exists.
maria_s: Customer asked for a credit and root-cause explanation. They want ETA for fix and whether this affected other requests in last 24h.
billing_team: We can do manual credits for affected invoices > $5. Send list of request_ids + invoice_ids. We'll need evidence (ledger rows) to attach.
alex_r: PR created: add dedupe key + finalized flag. Also adding unit test: simulate stream cancel + duplicate finalizer call -> ledger should not double-write.
jordan_p: After PR, I'll run soak on staging and grep for similar patterns (`finalizer_flush` alongside `stream_chunk_sent`) across the last 48h in staging logs.
ops_oncall: If patch passes, I can roll hotfix to prod during low traffic window tomorrow 06:00 PT. Ping me after reviews.
maria_s: I'll compile list of affected request_ids from customer and internal search and DM billing_team. Told customer we have a patch pending and will follow up with credits. Thanks all :thumbsup:
